description_en: Queries the endpoint services that are available to you
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser查询可使用的终端节点服务
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-vpc-endpoint-services-by-end-user --service-name com.aliyun.cn-hangzhou.oss --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser

parameters.help_en: The name of the endpoint service to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的终端节点服务的名称
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the gateway endpoint to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网关终端节点所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Services.description_en: The list of available endpoint services
Services.description_zh: 查询到可使用的终端节点服务列表信息

items.description_en: The list of available endpoint services
items.description_zh: 查询到可使用的终端节点服务列表信息

ServiceDomain.description_en: The domain name of the cloud service associated with the endpoint service in the queried region
ServiceDomain.description_zh: 终端节点服务所属云产品在查询地域的域名

ServiceId.description_en: The instance ID of the endpoint service

ServiceName.description_en: The name of the endpoint service

SupportPolicy.description_en:
Indicates whether the endpoint service supports access policies. Valid values:

false: Access policies are not supported.
true: Access policies are supported
SupportPolicy.description_zh:
终端节点服务是否支持设置访问策略。取值：

false：不支持设置访问策略。
true：支持设置访问策略

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
